items.title: 日本收緊外國人政策！永久居留新規10/1上路  高市早苗：經營管理簽證大減90%
items.title_en: Japan Tightens Policies on Foreign Residents! New Permanent Residency Rules Take Effect on Oct. 1, Prime Minister Kasuya Says Business‑Management Visas Down 90%
paras: 日本首相高市早苗週末透過社群媒體發文，強調政府正推動修改與外國人士相關的日本規定，而部分新規將於本週四（10月1日）生效。
根據《彭博》報導，高市表示，政府注意到，隨著在日外國居民人數增加，部分日本民眾產生不安或不公平感。因此，政府持續檢討相關制度，目的是「維持秩序」，並讓日本民眾與外國人士都能「安全、安心地生活」。
高市在一系列貼文中列舉多項政策調整，包括已經實施的措施，例如收緊簽證規定，以及加強打擊非法居留。
為了展現政府政策的成果，高市表示，今年上半年核發的「經營・管理」類別簽證數量，較去年同期大減90%。她也指出，2026年上半年遣返人數較去年同期增加15%。
高市發文之際，日本永久居留相關新規將於週四生效。其中一項要求是，永久居民須維持高於全國平均水準的收入。政府後續規劃的其他規定，則包括要求申請者證明具備日語能力，以及了解相關規則。
高市表示：「為確保日本民眾與外國人士都能安全、安心地生活，我們將持續推動嚴格且順暢的出入境管理與居留管理。」
日本政府目前正全面檢討外國人士及移民相關政策，範圍從最快2028年向入境日本的旅客收取費用，到收緊希望在日本生活及工作的外國人士之簽證條件。
相關民調顯示，日本民眾對增加外國居民的議題存在不安。東京大學8月公布的一項調查顯示，2026年有56.3%的受訪者反對增加在日外國人士，2024年這一比例為35.6%。調查也發現，反對移民的情緒在年輕世代中升幅更為明顯。
《每日新聞》去年11月進行的另一項民調則顯示，71%的受訪者支持高市收緊外國居民相關限制的措施，反對者占10%。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Japanese Prime Minister Kasuya Sanae posted on social media over the weekend, emphasizing that the government is pushing to amend Japan’s rules concerning foreign nationals, with some of the new regulations coming into force this Thursday, October 1.

According to Bloomberg, Kasuya said the government has noticed that as the number of foreign residents in Japan rises, some Japanese citizens are feeling uneasy or perceive unfairness. Consequently, the government continues to review the relevant systems with the aim of “maintaining order” and allowing both Japanese people and foreigners to “live safely and securely.”
Kasuya listed several policy adjustments in a series of posts, including measures already in place such as tightening visa requirements and stepping up the crackdown on illegal stays.

To showcase the government’s policy results, Kasuya noted that the number of “business‑management” visas issued in the first half of this year fell by 90% compared with the same period last year, and she also pointed out that the number of deportations in the first half of 2026 was up 15% from the previous year’s figure.

When Kasuya posted, new rules on permanent residency were set to take effect on Thursday. One requirement is that permanent residents must maintain an income level above the national average. Other forthcoming regulations will require applicants to demonstrate Japanese language proficiency and an understanding of the relevant rules.
Kasuya said, “To ensure that both Japanese citizens and foreign nationals can live safely and securely, we will continue to promote strict yet smooth immigration and residency management.”

The Japanese government is currently conducting a comprehensive review of policies affecting foreigners and immigrants, ranging from potentially charging inbound travelers as early as 2028 to tightening visa conditions for those wishing to live and work in Japan.

Polls show that the Japanese public feels uneasy about increasing the number of foreign residents. A University of Tokyo survey released in August found that 56.3% of respondents opposed an increase in foreign residents in 2026, up from 35.6% in 2024, with anti‑immigration sentiment rising most sharply among younger generations.
Another poll by Mainichi Shimbun conducted in November last year showed that 71% of respondents supported Kasuya’s stricter measures on foreign residents, while 10% opposed them.

items.title: 電動車強制令掰了！川普今公布新車油耗標準  專家：恐阻礙電動化轉型、削弱車廠競爭力
items.title_en: Trump Announces New Fuel Economy Standards, Dismantling EV Mandate; Experts Warn It Could Hinder Electrification and Weaken Automakers' Competitiveness
paras: 美國總統川普上周六(26日)宣布，將在周一(28日)公布針對乘用車與輕型卡車的燃油新標準，全面推翻上屆拜登政府的「電動車強制令」，大幅放寬油耗規定，此舉料將減緩美國汽車業電動化轉型腳步，恐削弱美國車廠長期競爭力。
美國運輸部長Sean Duffy表示，周一公布的新規將是「美國汽車工人的重大勝利」。
根據交通部估算，新標準雖可降低造車成本，平均每輛車減少930美元，但將增加燃油消耗與碳排放，預計到2050年，美國將多消耗1000億加侖燃油、多支出1850億美元油費，並多排放約5%的二氧化碳。
雖然最終標準尚未公布，但根據去年12月提出的草案，到2031款車型年度，平均燃油效率標準將放寬至每加侖34.5英里(約每百公里6.9公升)，遠低於拜登政府原定每加侖50.4英里(約每百公里4.7公升)的嚴格要求。
《紐約時報》分析指出，新政策鼓勵車廠生產高油耗的大型皮卡與休旅車，短期雖能帶來利潤，長期卻恐讓美國車廠落後於外國競爭對手。在全球電動車銷售火熱之際，放緩轉型步伐被視為戰略失策。
此舉也引發環保團體強烈反彈。環保組織「山嶺俱樂部」打算提告，主管Katherine García批評川普政府「給汽車製造商一張污染免費通行證」，讓美國民眾承擔更高的加油與醫療費用。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump announced last Saturday (the 26th) that on Monday (the 28th) he will unveil new fuel‑economy standards for passenger cars and light‑truck vehicles, completely overturning the Biden administration’s “electric‑vehicle mandate” and dramatically relaxing fuel‑efficiency rules. The move is expected to slow the U.S. auto industry’s shift toward electrification and could weaken the long‑term competitiveness of American car makers.
U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said the new rules to be released on Monday will be “a major victory for American auto workers.”

According to estimates from the Department of Transportation, the new standards could lower vehicle‑building costs by about $930 per vehicle on average, but they would increase fuel consumption and carbon emissions. By 2050, the United States would consume an additional 100 billion gallons of gasoline, spend an extra $185 billion on fuel, and emit roughly 5% more carbon dioxide.

Although the final standards have not yet been published, a draft released in December last year indicated that for model‑year 2031 vehicles the average fuel‑efficiency target would be relaxed to 34.5 miles per gallon (about 6.9 L/100 km), far below the Biden administration’s original strict target of 50.4 miles per gallon (about 4.7 L/100 km).

A New York Times analysis noted that the new policy encourages manufacturers to produce high‑fuel‑consumption large pickups and SUVs, which may boost short‑term profits but could leave U.S. automakers lagging behind foreign rivals in the long run. With global electric‑vehicle sales booming, slowing the transition is seen as a strategic misstep.

The move has also sparked strong backlash from environmental groups. The “Mountain Club” environmental organization plans to file a lawsuit; its head Katherine García criticized the Trump administration for giving automakers a “free pass to pollute,” which would force Americans to bear higher gasoline and health‑care costs.

items.title: 美股股票供給潮恐使AI泡沫破裂！GMO警告：SpaceX解禁、OpenAI上市恐壓抑報酬
items.title_en: U.S. Stock Supply Surge Could Burst AI Bubble, GMO Warns: SpaceX Unlock, OpenAI IPO May Suppress Returns
paras: 資產管理公司GMO近日在給客戶的季度報告中警告，隨著SpaceX(SPCX-US) 內部人士持股解禁、大型IPO即將登場，以及市場次級發行增加，美國股市可能迎來一波股票供給潮，進而對市場報酬造成壓力，甚至可能成為AI泡沫破裂的催化劑。
根據《Business Insider》報導，GMO指出，除了執行長馬斯克個人出售的股票之外，SpaceX其他股票出售規模合計也約相當於美國股市總市值的1%。
另一方面，GMO估計，預計即將上市的OpenAI與Anthropic，兩家公司合計約占美股可投資總市值的5%。
GMO表示，整體而言，美國股票供給量每年可能增加約5%，相較之下，歷史上股票供給量平均每年縮減1%。
GMO資產配置聯席主管Ben Inker與資產配置研究主管John Pease在報告中寫道：「如今以被動投資、基準指數意識及各種限制為特徵的市場，使願意吸收新增股票供給的買方變得更少。」
報告補充：「我們認為，目前已進入市場的股票供給規模已足以對可能的報酬產生顯著抑制效果；如果歷史經驗仍具有一定參考價值，未來一年半的報酬可能較正常水準低約20%。」
Inker與Pease進一步指出，即將出現的大量新股供給，也可能成為AI泡沫破裂的催化劑。近年市場對股票供給變化的敏感度已提高。
兩人表示，在一個對股票供給如此敏感的市場中，價格可能會在市場真正了解發生什麼事之前率先轉向。
近期市場對公開交易股票供給快速增加的關注也日益升高。SpaceX規模達2兆美元的IPO引發分析師對公開市場結構的疑慮，市場擔心，大量新股發行可能抽走其他市場領域的流動性，因投資人為新上市的大型科技股配置資金，可能需要調整既有持股。
今年IPO市場同樣創下紀錄。根據美國證券交易委員會（SEC）資料，今年上半年新上市公司募資金額超過1370億美元，年增幅接近400%。
與此同時，投資人手上的閒置現金並不充裕。美銀最新機構投資人調查顯示，全球股票配置比重已接近5年高點。
部分分析師因此擔心，當投資人需要承接大量新上市股票時，可能被迫出售部分既有股票持倉，進而對更廣泛的股市造成壓力。
paras_en: Asset manager GMO warned in its quarterly client report that a wave of stock supply could hit the U.S. market as SpaceX (SPCX‑US) insiders’ shares unlock, large IPOs loom, and secondary offerings increase, potentially pressuring market returns and even acting as a catalyst for an AI bubble burst.

According to Business Insider, GMO noted that beyond the shares sold by CEO Elon Musk personally, the total size of other SpaceX share sales is roughly equivalent to about 1% of the total market capitalization of U.S. equities.
GMO also estimated that the upcoming IPOs of OpenAI and Anthropic together would represent about 5% of the investable market cap of U.S. stocks.
GMO said that overall U.S. stock supply could rise by about 5% per year, whereas historically the annual supply has on average contracted by 1%.

Ben Inker, co‑head of asset allocation at GMO, and John Pease, head of asset allocation research, wrote in the report: “Today’s market, characterized by passive investing, benchmark‑index awareness and various constraints, leaves fewer buyers willing to absorb new stock supply.”

The report added: “We believe the amount of stock supply already entering the market is sufficient to significantly suppress potential returns; if historical experience remains a useful guide, returns over the next 18 months could be about 20% lower than normal levels.”

Inker and Pease further pointed out that the imminent flood of new shares could also serve as a catalyst for an AI bubble burst, noting that market sensitivity to changes in stock supply has risen in recent years.
They said that in a market so sensitive to stock supply, prices may turn before the market fully understands what is happening.

Recent attention to the rapid increase in publicly traded stock supply is growing. The $2 trillion SpaceX IPO has raised analyst concerns about public market structure, with worries that a massive influx of new shares could siphon liquidity from other market segments as investors allocate capital to newly listed mega‑tech stocks and may need to rebalance existing holdings.
This year’s IPO market also set records. SEC data show that in the first half of the year, newly listed companies raised over $137 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of nearly 400%.
At the same time, investors do not have abundant idle cash. A latest Bank of America institutional investor survey shows that global equity allocation is near a five‑year high.

Some analysts therefore worry that when investors need to take on a large volume of newly listed stocks, they may be forced to sell portions of existing holdings, putting broader pressure on the equity market.

items.title: 美財長貝森特籲Fed保持「開放態度」：AI生產率紅利或緩解通膨壓力
items.title_en: Treasury Secretary Borenstein Urges Fed to Keep an "Open Mind": AI Productivity Gains Could Ease Inflation Pressure
paras: 美國財長貝森特最新呼籲，Fed在評估通膨與利率路徑時應保持「開放態度」，他並認為AI帶來的生產率提升以及監管放鬆，有望擴大美國經濟的供給能力，進而從根本上抑制價格壓力。
貝森特此番發言正值Fed本月重啟升息、市場重估緊縮幅度之際，凸顯財政部與貨幣政策當局在通膨判斷上的微妙分歧。
貝森特援引Fed前主席葛林斯潘的歷史經驗指出，在生產率快速提升的環境下，經濟具備更大的擴張空間。他認為，當前美國經濟正受益於減稅、監管放鬆及技術進步，決策官員不應忽視這些供給端的正面變化。
在通膨構成上，貝森特試圖區分「能源衝擊」與「基礎通膨」。他指出，儘管中東局勢推高汽油價格，加大消費者生活成本，但剔除能源與食品後的核心CPI表現相對溫和。
美國8月核心CPI年增2.4%，雖仍高於2%的目標，但近期實際已有所回落。貝森特認為，能源價格衝擊並不一定會轉化為廣泛的基礎通膨壓力。
然而，Fed立場更為謹慎。面對通膨風險，Fed本月中升息1碼至3.75%-4%，多位官員強調需保持政策的限制性。
貝森特則將當前AI發展類比於1990年代的網路革命，認為更快的生產率增長能允許經濟以更高速度運行，同時減輕工資上漲轉化為通脹的壓力。
這場關於「通膨來源」的辯論，亦即外部供給衝擊還是內部需求過熱所致，將決定Fed未來利率路徑，而貝森特最新表態則顯示，在Fed重啟升息後，財政部對進一步緊縮持保留態度，並希望為潛在增長率的提升保留政策空間。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Borenstein recently called on the Fed to maintain an "open mind" when assessing inflation and the interest‑rate path, arguing that productivity gains from AI and regulatory easing could expand the United States’ supply capacity and fundamentally curb price pressures.

Borenstein’s remarks come as the Fed resumes rate hikes this month and markets reassess the degree of monetary tightening, highlighting a subtle divergence between the Treasury and the central bank on how to judge inflation.

Citing former Fed Chair Alan Greenspan’s historical experience, Borenstein noted that an environment of rapid productivity growth gives the economy more room to expand. He said the U.S. economy is currently benefiting from tax cuts, deregulation and technological progress, and policymakers should not overlook these positive supply‑side developments.

On the composition of inflation, Borenstein tried to separate an "energy shock" from "core inflation." He pointed out that although Middle‑East tensions have pushed gasoline prices higher and increased consumer living costs, core CPI—excluding energy and food—has been relatively moderate.

U.S. core CPI rose 2.4% year‑over‑year in August, still above the 2% target but showing a recent decline. Borenstein said the energy price shock does not necessarily translate into broad‑based core inflation pressure.

The Fed, however, remains more cautious. Facing inflation risks, the central bank raised rates by a quarter point this month to a target range of 3.75%‑4%, and several officials emphasized the need to keep policy restrictive.

Borenstein likened the current AI boom to the internet revolution of the 1990s, arguing that faster productivity growth can allow the economy to run at a higher speed while easing the pressure of wage growth feeding into inflation.

The debate over the source of inflation—whether it stems from external supply shocks or overheated domestic demand—will shape the Fed’s future rate path. Borenstein’s latest stance shows that after the Fed’s rate‑hike restart, the Treasury remains hesitant about further tightening and wants to preserve policy space to boost the potential growth rate.

items.title: 金屬中心董事長交棒 由台灣金屬熱處理學會理事長吳忠春接任
items.title_en: Metal Center Chairman Passes the Baton to Wu Zhong-Chun, President of the Taiwan Metal Heat Treatment Society
paras: 金屬工業研究發展中心董事長交棒，由台灣金屬熱處理學會理事長吳忠春接任；吳忠春長期深耕金屬材料、熱處理技術及產學合作，可望進一步深化金屬中心「核心技術與新興應用並進」發展模式。
吳忠春現亦為南臺科技大學特聘教授，專長涵蓋金屬材料、顯微結構分析、熱處理分析等領域，兼具學術研究、人才培育與技術實務經驗，並長期與台灣金屬產業保持緊密連結，多年來持續投入產業技術交流與人才培育。
金屬中心表示，過去一年現任董事長劉嘉茹帶領中心積極跨域布局，串聯國內外產、學、研夥伴，讓中心累積多年的研發能量加速走向產業應用，新任董事長吳忠春除延續既有成果，更將結合其深厚的金屬材料專業與產學研實務經驗，進一步強化核心技術、產業需求與國際資源鏈結。
金屬中心表示，未來在吳忠春帶領下，一方面持續厚植金屬材料、熱處理、製程、節能等基礎實力，協助傳統產業升級；另一方面將這些核心技術更緊密銜接AI智慧製造、淨零能源、無人載具、半導體及高值製造等新興領域。
其中，智慧科技方面，金屬中心攜手中華電信導入AI、5G、雲端及資通訊技術，並布局智慧醫療，整合智慧手術機器人、智慧感測及精準治療等技術，串聯醫療體系推動遠距會診、術後監測及偏鄉、長照與在宅照護應用。
無人載具領域則已與美國國防科技大廠Anduril、法國無人機大廠Parrot等國際夥伴建立合作，並與中科院、愛知製鋼及國內相關單位深化無人機關鍵技術、測試驗證及磁石材料等布局，同時籌建無人機抗風驗證場域，並透過中華電信AI、5G及雲端技術推動智慧巡檢，持續強化無人載具自主技術與國際競爭力。
半導體領域也是近年重要布局，金屬中心正式啟用半導體檢測實驗室，並攜手SEMI及日立先端科技台灣，強化半導體設備與關鍵零組件檢測服務，透過檢測驗證、材料分析及製程改善等技術，協助南部金屬加工、精密機械及扣件業者切入半導體設備與零組件供應鏈。
paras_en: The chairman of the Metal Industry Research and Development Center has been succeeded by Wu Zhong‑Chun, who is also the president of the Taiwan Metal Heat Treatment Society. Wu has long been dedicated to metal materials, heat‑treatment technology, and industry‑academia collaboration, and is expected to further deepen the Center’s development model of advancing core technologies alongside emerging applications.

Wu Zhong‑Chun is currently a distinguished professor at Southern Taiwan University of Science and Technology, with expertise covering metal materials, microstructure analysis, and heat‑treatment analysis. He combines academic research, talent cultivation, and practical technical experience, and has maintained close ties with Taiwan’s metal industry, continuously contributing to industrial technology exchange and talent development over many years.

The Metal Center noted that over the past year, incumbent chairman Liu Jia‑Ru led the Center in actively pursuing cross‑domain initiatives, linking domestic and international industry, academia, and research partners, allowing years of R&D capacity to accelerate toward industrial application. The new chairman Wu Zhong‑Chun will not only continue existing achievements but also integrate his deep metal‑material expertise and industry‑academia‑research practice to further strengthen core technologies, industry needs, and international resource connections.

The Center said that under Wu’s leadership, it will continue to solidify foundational strengths in metal materials, heat treatment, processes, and energy efficiency to help upgrade traditional industries, while more tightly linking these core technologies with emerging fields such as AI‑driven smart manufacturing, net‑zero energy, unmanned vehicles, semiconductors, and high‑value manufacturing.

In the smart‑technology arena, the Metal Center is partnering with Chunghwa Telecom to introduce AI, 5G, cloud, and ICT technologies, and is positioning itself in smart healthcare by integrating intelligent surgical robots, smart sensing, and precision therapy to connect the medical system for remote consultations, postoperative monitoring, and applications in remote areas, long‑term care, and home‑based care.

In the unmanned‑vehicle sector, the Center has established collaborations with U.S. defense‑technology giant Anduril and French drone manufacturer Parrot, as well as deepening work with the Industrial Technology Research Institute, Aichi Steel, and relevant domestic entities on key drone technologies, testing verification, and magnetic‑material development. It is also building a wind‑resistance test field for drones and, using Chunghwa Telecom’s AI, 5G, and cloud capabilities, promoting intelligent inspection to continuously enhance autonomous unmanned‑vehicle technology and international competitiveness.

Semiconductors have also become a key focus in recent years. The Metal Center has officially launched a semiconductor inspection laboratory and is working with SEMI and Hitachi High‑Tech Taiwan to strengthen inspection services for semiconductor equipment and critical components. Through testing verification, material analysis, and process improvement, the Center aims to help southern metal‑processing, precision‑machinery, and fastener companies enter the semiconductor equipment and component supply chain.

items.title: 比爾蓋茲警告AI恐致10億人死亡！反駁川普：政府監管不會削弱美中競爭
items.title_en: Bill Gates Warns AI Could Cause One Billion Deaths, Counters Trump: Government Regulation Won't Undermine US-China Competition
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US) 共同創辦人比爾蓋茲（Bill Gates）警告，人工智慧（AI）已是「強大到足以」殺死大部分人類的工具，他也加入越來越多科技業領袖與員工的行列，呼籲外界正視AI可能對人類生存造成的風險，與美國總統川普大致不願積極介入的立場形成對比，並認為這不會讓美國落後於中國。
根據《彭博》報導，蓋茲在接受《NBC》訪問時表示，「AI確實強大到足以引發一些事件，導致10億人死亡。」
他表示：「從未有任何武器，能像懷有惡意的人使用最新AI工具這種組合一樣強大。」
蓋茲的立場也與川普相反。他認為，美國政府針對人工智慧（AI）潛在災難性風險建立安全防護措施，不會削弱美國與中國競爭的能力。
他說：「當然，所有國家都應該希望建立這些安全防護措施。所以對於那些聲稱『中國不會建立這些安全防護措施』的說法，我完全不同意。」
面對低迷的民調支持度，以及共和黨在11月選舉中力拚維持國會控制權，川普將AI可能威脅人類生存的警告形容為一場騙局，認為這種說法可能阻礙美國創新，並讓中國從中得利。
當被問及川普的相關言論時，蓋茲則表示：「這完全不是騙局。」
他預期，中國也會支持AI安全措施，因為中國同樣不希望成為攻擊目標。蓋茲並認為，川普在「聽取我以及其他人的意見後」，可能改變立場，其中包括讓川普了解，AI安全措施並不會削弱美國在他所認為的「國家間競爭」中的能力。
隨著AI模型能力快速提升，矽谷近期對AI可能造成災難性後果的警告也持續增加。
Anthropic員工Jacob Coxon本月稍早離職，並公開批評Anthropic與OpenAI持續競逐超級智慧AI，形容相關企業是在拿人類生命「下注」，因為兩家公司正「競相開發超級智慧AI」。
另一名Anthropic員工則表示，他認為AI在未來10年消滅全人類的機率超過10%。
這些言論讓原本長期存在於AI產業內部、且具爭議性的AI生存風險討論，進一步受到大眾關注，也引發外界要求AI業者強化安全措施。
Anthropic執行長阿莫戴（Dario Amodei）此後呼籲放緩AI開發速度，OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）及馬斯克等人也表達支持。
蓋茲認為，面對AI可能帶來的風險，業界自律並不足夠，政府及執法機構必須參與制定安全防護與監控機制，並將相關要求納入強制規範。
蓋茲此前也曾在8月發表文章指出，隨著AI工具能力持續提升，惡意人士可能利用AI發動網路攻擊、詐欺及散播錯誤資訊，並對醫院、金融機構、電網及政府系統等造成大規模傷害。
對於「kill switch」（緊急關停開關）概念，也就是確保人類在強大AI模型開始出現危險行為時，仍有能力停止或限制模型運作，蓋茲則指出，這項措施「還不夠」，也無法取代更早階段的監督機制。
他表示：「我們確實需要監控任何複雜的模型，並完整記錄究竟進行了哪些操作。美國應該確保這些措施落實，中國也會希望這麼做。」
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) co‑founder Bill Gates warned that artificial intelligence (AI) is already "powerful enough" to become a tool that could kill most of humanity. He joined a growing number of tech leaders and employees urging the world to take the existential risks of AI seriously, contrasting with President Donald Trump’s generally reluctant stance on active involvement, and he believes this will not let the United States fall behind China.
According to Bloomberg, Gates told NBC that "AI is indeed powerful enough to trigger events that could lead to one billion deaths."
He said, "No weapon has ever been as powerful as the combination of malicious people using the latest AI tools."
Gates’s position also runs opposite to Trump’s. He believes that U.S. government safety measures against AI’s potentially catastrophic risks will not weaken America’s ability to compete with China.
He added, "Of course every country should want to build these safety safeguards. So I completely disagree with the claim that ‘China won’t build these safeguards.’"

Facing low poll support and a Republican push to retain congressional control in the November election, Trump dismissed the warning that AI could threaten human survival as a hoax, arguing that such claims could stifle U.S. innovation and benefit China.
When asked about Trump’s remarks, Gates responded, "It is absolutely not a hoax."

He expects China will also back AI safety measures because it likewise does not want to become a target of attacks. Gates believes that after "listening to me and others," Trump might change his stance, including understanding that AI safety does not diminish U.S. capability in what he calls "inter‑national competition."
As AI model capabilities surge, warnings from Silicon Valley about possible disastrous outcomes have been mounting recently.

Anthropic employee Jacob Coxon left the company earlier this month and publicly criticized Anthropic and OpenAI for racing toward super‑intelligent AI, describing the firms as "betting on human lives" as they "compete to develop super‑intelligent AI."
Another Anthropic employee said he believes the probability that AI will wipe out all humanity within the next ten years exceeds 10%.

These statements have brought the long‑standing, controversial internal AI‑industry debate over existential risk into the public eye, prompting calls for stronger safety measures from outside the sector.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei subsequently urged a slowdown in AI development, and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman as well as Elon Musk also voiced support for the call.

Gates argues that industry self‑regulation is insufficient to address AI risks; governments and law‑enforcement agencies must take part in creating safety safeguards and monitoring mechanisms, and embed those requirements into binding regulations.

Gates previously wrote in August that as AI tools become more capable, malicious actors could use AI to launch cyber attacks, fraud and disinformation, causing large‑scale harm to hospitals, financial institutions, power grids and government systems.

Regarding the "kill switch" concept—ensuring humanity can shut down or limit a powerful AI model when it begins to behave dangerously—Gates said the measure is "still not enough" and cannot replace earlier‑stage oversight mechanisms.

He said, "We do need to monitor any complex model and fully log what operations are being performed. The United States should ensure these measures are implemented, and China would also want to do the same."
(This article is not open for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 〈VSMC開幕〉VSMC一期全滿 方略：二期規劃加速 不排除導入28/22奈米
items.title_en: VSMC Opening: Phase‑1 Fully Booked, Strategy Accelerates Phase‑2 Planning, May Adopt 28/22‑nm Process
paras: 世界先進(5347-TW)暨VSMC董事長方略今(28)日表示，目前VSMC進度優於預期，今年第四季就有機會進入風險性試產，維持明年第一季量產計畫，包括電源以及矽中介層(Interposer)等產品都會開始產出，包括損益兩平、獲利、滿載的時間點都有機會提前，甚至已經接獲不少客戶需求，正在評估各項條件，坦言二期規劃正在加速中，也不排除更進一步往22/28奈米製程前進。
VSMC一期採用130奈米至40奈米製程，生產混合訊號、電源管理、類比產品及矽中介層等產品，預期2029年產能達滿載，每月產能為12吋44,000片晶圓，可望創造約1,600個工作機會。
方略指出，一期產能已全數被客戶預訂，後續新增需求只能等待二期開出，因此公司已開始蒐集財務、客戶需求及技術定位等相關條件，暗示會在「短暫的將來」評估二期的啟動時程。對於外界關注二期是否可能在今年底定案、明年動工，方略則表示，公司沒有那麼著急，仍會「謀定而後動」，但一旦決定啟動，就會快速執行。
VSMC目前已開始初步蒐集二期所需評估的各項條件，包括財務狀況、客戶需求、技術定位與應用方向。方略強調，12吋晶圓廠投資金額龐大，如果定位錯誤，未來可能形成結構性問題，因此一定要把財務、需求與技術方向都想清楚後才會正式啟動。
方略認為，相較第一期，未來二期若正式啟動，整體難度將相對降低。隨著第一座12吋廠跨過建廠與量產門檻，世界先進營收將大幅成長，未來進行第二座廠投資時，財務壓力可望下降。此外，經歷一期建廠後，團隊的建廠經驗與執行能力都已大幅提升，且部分廠務設施與建築基礎已經完成，因此理論上二期的啟動難度也會低於一期。
針對二期是否可能引進第三個合作夥伴，方略則明確表示，目前沒有這項規劃，二期仍會與恩智浦(NXPI-US)共同合作，不會再尋找第三方加入。
量產進度方面，方略表示，今年第四季已有機會進行部分風險性試產，但正式計畫仍維持明年第一季進入量產的目標，目前看來第一季量產的把握度相當高，產品將涵蓋電源管理及矽中介層(Interposer)等相關產品。
至於原先規劃2029年達到滿載，方略表示，以目前進度來看，「應該要達成是沒有什麼問題的目標」，甚至有機會提前實現。
對於二期投資金額與技術內容，方略仍保持審慎。他指出，真正決定投資規模的關鍵，在於未來要做什麼產品、採用什麼技術與鎖定何種應用，目前這些定位尚未完全確定，因此仍不宜過早給出具體數字。
方略強調，一旦二期的技術與產品方向確定，公司就能進一步說明投資金額、產能與時程；現階段最重要的仍是持續聽取客戶需求，確保新的12吋投資能建立在清楚且可長期發展的市場定位之上。
paras_en: World Advanced (5347‑TW) and VSMC Chairman Fang Lue said today (the 28th) that VSMC’s progress is ahead of schedule and that a risky pilot run could begin in Q4 this year, keeping the plan for mass production in Q1 next year. Power‑management chips and silicon interposer products will start shipping, and break‑even, profitability and full‑load milestones could all be moved forward. The company has already received numerous customer requests and is evaluating the conditions, noting that Phase‑2 planning is being accelerated and that moving to a 22/28‑nm process is not ruled out.

Phase‑1 uses 130‑nm to 40‑nm processes to produce mixed‑signal, power‑management, analog and silicon‑interposer products. Full capacity is expected by 2029, with a monthly output of 44,000 12‑inch wafers, which could create about 1,600 jobs.

Fang noted that Phase‑1 capacity is already fully booked, and any additional demand will have to wait for Phase‑2. The company has begun gathering financial, customer‑demand and technology‑positioning data, hinting that it will assess the Phase‑2 start‑up timing in the "near future." Regarding speculation that Phase‑2 could be finalized by year‑end and break ground next year, he said the company is not in a hurry, will plan carefully before acting, but will move quickly once a decision is made.

VSMC has started to collect the various conditions needed to evaluate Phase‑2, including financial status, customer demand, technology positioning and application direction. Fang stressed that a 12‑inch fab requires massive investment, and a wrong positioning could create structural problems, so all financial, demand and technical aspects must be clarified before formally launching Phase‑2.

Fang believes that, compared with Phase‑1, the overall difficulty of a formally launched Phase‑2 will be lower. With the first 12‑inch fab crossing construction and mass‑production thresholds, World Advanced’s revenue will grow sharply, reducing financial pressure for a second fab. Moreover, after building Phase‑1, the team’s construction experience and execution capability have improved markedly, and some facilities and building foundations are already in place, so theoretically Phase‑2 should be easier to start than Phase‑1.

Regarding whether a third partner might join Phase‑2, Fang stated clearly that there is no such plan; Phase‑2 will continue to be a joint effort with NXP (NXPI‑US) and no additional partner will be sought.

On mass‑production timing, Fang said there is an opportunity for limited risky pilot runs in Q4 this year, but the official schedule still targets mass production in Q1 next year. The outlook for a Q1 start is strong, and the product lineup will include power‑management chips and silicon interposers among others.
As for the original plan to reach full capacity by 2029, Fang said that at the current pace "there is no problem achieving that goal" and it may even be reached earlier.

Fang remains cautious about the investment amount and technical scope of Phase‑2. He noted that the key to determining the scale of investment lies in the future product mix, the technologies to be used and the target applications, which have not yet been fully defined, so it is premature to give concrete figures.

He emphasized that once the technology and product direction for Phase‑2 are settled, the company can specify the investment amount, capacity and schedule. For now, the priority is to keep listening to customer needs and ensure that the new 12‑inch investment is built on a clear, long‑term market positioning.

items.title: 〈VSMC開幕〉方略：產能已經「徹底爆掉」 成熟製程缺貨恐延續多年
items.title_en: <VSMC Opening> Fang Lue: Capacity Has Been "Completely Exhausted"; Mature Process Shortages May Persist for Years
paras: 世界先進(5347-TW)暨VSMC董事長方略今(28)日表示，AI浪潮對全球半導體產生明顯的產能排擠效應，不只AI相關需求強勁，許多非AI應用的成熟製程產能也同步受到擠壓，世界先進目前8吋產能利用率已經「徹底爆掉」，大家都嫌不夠，預期此次AI浪潮帶來的缺貨效應將持續相當長的一段時間。
方略指出，目前全球半導體產業面臨的最大趨勢，就是AI帶動的大規模投資，使得相關資金、電力、水力、人才與產能持續向AI領域集中，也進一步排擠其他應用所需產能。世界先進本身同樣受惠AI趨勢，但另一方面，非AI相關應用也因產能被排擠，讓整體供應更加吃緊。
他認為，從目前狀況來看，全球半導體供不應求並非短期現象，而可能維持相當長一段時間。尤其這一波需求與過去成熟製程常見的季節性景氣循環不同，不像過去短期上上下下後很快恢復平衡，而是可能延續更久。
方略直言，目前全球幾乎沒有一家半導體業者能說自己有足夠產能完全滿足需求，不論亞洲、美洲或歐洲，產能都相當吃緊。
談到世界先進既有8吋產能，方略更以「徹底爆掉」形容目前利用率狀況，坦言市場需求強到大家都嫌產能不夠，AI帶來的排擠效應，也讓原本成熟製程的供需結構出現明顯變化。
除了傳統成熟製程需求外，新的AI相關應用也進一步擴大成熟製程需求，世界先進在AI Edge、Smart Power System等領域已具備不錯的位置，未來隨VSMC加入，公司在AI相關市場的布局可望進一步加深。
另外，台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)也將矽中介層(Silicon Interposer)外包給與世界先進，成為VSMC成熟製程的新需求來源。方略指出，矽中介層是先進封裝中的核心元件之一，目前在VSMC規劃中的占比已相當顯著，但由於相關製程步驟較多、需要更多設備，也因此壓縮無塵室空間，進一步限制整體晶圓產出。
至於這波供不應求何時才會出現明顯緩解，方略表示，目前市場看法分歧，有人認為要到2027年底，也有人認為會延續至2028年，甚至有人判斷到2030年都還無法完全滿足需求，現階段仍難以準確預測。
他也強調，即便外界開始出現AI投資可能放緩的討論，也不代表半導體產能會因此突然空出來。從目前趨勢來看，AI需求已具備相當強的延續性，短期內並沒有看到供需反轉的跡象。
paras_en: World Advanced (5347-TW) and VSMC Chairman Fang Lue said today (the 28th) that the AI wave is creating a clear capacity‑crowding effect in the global semiconductor industry. Not only is AI‑related demand strong, but many non‑AI mature‑process capacities are also being squeezed. World Advanced’s 8‑inch capacity utilization is already "completely exhausted"—everyone complains it’s not enough. The shortage effect driven by this AI wave is expected to last for a considerable period of time.

Fang pointed out that the biggest trend facing the global semiconductor industry today is the massive AI‑driven investment, which concentrates capital, electricity, water, talent and capacity in the AI sector and further crowds out capacity needed for other applications. World Advanced also benefits from the AI trend, but on the other hand, non‑AI applications are suffering from the capacity squeeze, tightening overall supply.

He believes that, based on the current situation, the global semiconductor supply shortage is not a short‑term phenomenon and may persist for a fairly long time. This wave of demand differs from the usual seasonal cycles of mature processes; unlike past short‑term fluctuations that quickly rebalance, this shortage could last much longer.

Fang bluntly stated that almost no semiconductor company worldwide can claim to have enough capacity to fully meet demand. Whether in Asia, the Americas or Europe, capacity is extremely tight everywhere.

Discussing World Advanced’s existing 8‑inch capacity, Fang described the utilization as "completely exhausted," admitting that market demand is so strong that everyone feels capacity is insufficient. The AI‑induced crowding effect has also caused a noticeable shift in the supply‑demand structure of mature processes.

In addition to traditional mature‑process demand, new AI‑related applications are further expanding the need for mature processes. World Advanced already holds a solid position in AI Edge and Smart Power System fields, and with VSMC’s addition, the company’s AI market footprint is expected to deepen further.

Moreover, TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) will outsource silicon interposer production to World Advanced, creating a new source of demand for VSMC’s mature processes. Fang noted that silicon interposers are a core component of advanced packaging; they now represent a significant share of VSMC’s roadmap, but the many process steps and equipment requirements compress clean‑room space, further limiting overall wafer output.

Regarding when this supply‑demand imbalance might ease, Fang said market opinions diverge: some see relief only by the end of 2027, others think it could extend into 2028, and some even predict that demand won’t be fully met until 2030. At present, accurate forecasting remains difficult.

He also emphasized that even if discussions arise about a possible slowdown in AI investment, it does not mean semiconductor capacity will suddenly become available. Current trends show AI demand has strong continuity, and there are no signs of a supply‑demand reversal in the short term.

items.title: 金屬中心董事長交棒 由台灣金屬熱處理學會理事長吳忠春接任
items.title_en: Metal Center Chairman Passes the Baton to Wu Zhong-Chun, President of the Taiwan Metal Heat Treatment Society
paras: 金屬工業研究發展中心董事長交棒，由台灣金屬熱處理學會理事長吳忠春接任；吳忠春長期深耕金屬材料、熱處理技術及產學合作，可望進一步深化金屬中心「核心技術與新興應用並進」發展模式。
吳忠春現亦為南臺科技大學特聘教授，專長涵蓋金屬材料、顯微結構分析、熱處理分析等領域，兼具學術研究、人才培育與技術實務經驗，並長期與台灣金屬產業保持緊密連結，多年來持續投入產業技術交流與人才培育。
金屬中心表示，過去一年現任董事長劉嘉茹帶領中心積極跨域布局，串聯國內外產、學、研夥伴，讓中心累積多年的研發能量加速走向產業應用，新任董事長吳忠春除延續既有成果，更將結合其深厚的金屬材料專業與產學研實務經驗，進一步強化核心技術、產業需求與國際資源鏈結。
金屬中心表示，未來在吳忠春帶領下，一方面持續厚植金屬材料、熱處理、製程、節能等基礎實力，協助傳統產業升級；另一方面將這些核心技術更緊密銜接AI智慧製造、淨零能源、無人載具、半導體及高值製造等新興領域。
其中，智慧科技方面，金屬中心攜手中華電信導入AI、5G、雲端及資通訊技術，並布局智慧醫療，整合智慧手術機器人、智慧感測及精準治療等技術，串聯醫療體系推動遠距會診、術後監測及偏鄉、長照與在宅照護應用。
無人載具領域則已與美國國防科技大廠Anduril、法國無人機大廠Parrot等國際夥伴建立合作，並與中科院、愛知製鋼及國內相關單位深化無人機關鍵技術、測試驗證及磁石材料等布局，同時籌建無人機抗風驗證場域，並透過中華電信AI、5G及雲端技術推動智慧巡檢，持續強化無人載具自主技術與國際競爭力。
半導體領域也是近年重要布局，金屬中心正式啟用半導體檢測實驗室，並攜手SEMI及日立先端科技台灣，強化半導體設備與關鍵零組件檢測服務，透過檢測驗證、材料分析及製程改善等技術，協助南部金屬加工、精密機械及扣件業者切入半導體設備與零組件供應鏈。
paras_en: The chairman of the Metal Industry Research and Development Center has been succeeded by Wu Zhong‑Chun, who is also the president of the Taiwan Metal Heat Treatment Society. Wu has long been dedicated to metal materials, heat‑treatment technology, and industry‑academia collaboration, and is expected to further deepen the Center’s development model of advancing core technologies alongside emerging applications.

Wu Zhong‑Chun is currently a distinguished professor at Southern Taiwan University of Science and Technology, with expertise covering metal materials, microstructure analysis, and heat‑treatment analysis. He combines academic research, talent cultivation, and practical technical experience, and has maintained close ties with Taiwan’s metal industry, continuously contributing to industrial technology exchange and talent development over many years.

The Metal Center noted that over the past year, incumbent chairman Liu Jia‑Ru led the Center in actively pursuing cross‑domain initiatives, linking domestic and international industry, academia, and research partners, allowing years of R&D capacity to accelerate toward industrial application. The new chairman Wu Zhong‑Chun will not only continue existing achievements but also integrate his deep metal‑material expertise and industry‑academia‑research practice to further strengthen core technologies, industry needs, and international resource connections.

The Center said that under Wu’s leadership, it will continue to solidify foundational strengths in metal materials, heat treatment, processes, and energy efficiency to help upgrade traditional industries, while more tightly linking these core technologies with emerging fields such as AI‑driven smart manufacturing, net‑zero energy, unmanned vehicles, semiconductors, and high‑value manufacturing.

In the smart‑technology arena, the Metal Center is partnering with Chunghwa Telecom to introduce AI, 5G, cloud, and ICT technologies, and is positioning itself in smart healthcare by integrating intelligent surgical robots, smart sensing, and precision therapy to connect the medical system for remote consultations, postoperative monitoring, and applications in remote areas, long‑term care, and home‑based care.

In the unmanned‑vehicle sector, the Center has established collaborations with U.S. defense‑technology giant Anduril and French drone manufacturer Parrot, as well as deepening work with the Industrial Technology Research Institute, Aichi Steel, and relevant domestic entities on key drone technologies, testing verification, and magnetic‑material development. It is also building a wind‑resistance test field for drones and, using Chunghwa Telecom’s AI, 5G, and cloud capabilities, promoting intelligent inspection to continuously enhance autonomous unmanned‑vehicle technology and international competitiveness.

Semiconductors have also become a key focus in recent years. The Metal Center has officially launched a semiconductor inspection laboratory and is working with SEMI and Hitachi High‑Tech Taiwan to strengthen inspection services for semiconductor equipment and critical components. Through testing verification, material analysis, and process improvement, the Center aims to help southern metal‑processing, precision‑machinery, and fastener companies enter the semiconductor equipment and component supply chain.

items.title: 〈VSMC開幕〉VSMC一期全滿 方略：二期規劃加速 不排除導入28/22奈米
items.title_en: VSMC Opening: Phase‑1 Fully Booked, Strategy Accelerates Phase‑2 Planning, May Adopt 28/22‑nm Process
paras: 世界先進(5347-TW)暨VSMC董事長方略今(28)日表示，目前VSMC進度優於預期，今年第四季就有機會進入風險性試產，維持明年第一季量產計畫，包括電源以及矽中介層(Interposer)等產品都會開始產出，包括損益兩平、獲利、滿載的時間點都有機會提前，甚至已經接獲不少客戶需求，正在評估各項條件，坦言二期規劃正在加速中，也不排除更進一步往22/28奈米製程前進。
VSMC一期採用130奈米至40奈米製程，生產混合訊號、電源管理、類比產品及矽中介層等產品，預期2029年產能達滿載，每月產能為12吋44,000片晶圓，可望創造約1,600個工作機會。
方略指出，一期產能已全數被客戶預訂，後續新增需求只能等待二期開出，因此公司已開始蒐集財務、客戶需求及技術定位等相關條件，暗示會在「短暫的將來」評估二期的啟動時程。對於外界關注二期是否可能在今年底定案、明年動工，方略則表示，公司沒有那麼著急，仍會「謀定而後動」，但一旦決定啟動，就會快速執行。
VSMC目前已開始初步蒐集二期所需評估的各項條件，包括財務狀況、客戶需求、技術定位與應用方向。方略強調，12吋晶圓廠投資金額龐大，如果定位錯誤，未來可能形成結構性問題，因此一定要把財務、需求與技術方向都想清楚後才會正式啟動。
方略認為，相較第一期，未來二期若正式啟動，整體難度將相對降低。隨著第一座12吋廠跨過建廠與量產門檻，世界先進營收將大幅成長，未來進行第二座廠投資時，財務壓力可望下降。此外，經歷一期建廠後，團隊的建廠經驗與執行能力都已大幅提升，且部分廠務設施與建築基礎已經完成，因此理論上二期的啟動難度也會低於一期。
針對二期是否可能引進第三個合作夥伴，方略則明確表示，目前沒有這項規劃，二期仍會與恩智浦(NXPI-US)共同合作，不會再尋找第三方加入。
量產進度方面，方略表示，今年第四季已有機會進行部分風險性試產，但正式計畫仍維持明年第一季進入量產的目標，目前看來第一季量產的把握度相當高，產品將涵蓋電源管理及矽中介層(Interposer)等相關產品。
至於原先規劃2029年達到滿載，方略表示，以目前進度來看，「應該要達成是沒有什麼問題的目標」，甚至有機會提前實現。
對於二期投資金額與技術內容，方略仍保持審慎。他指出，真正決定投資規模的關鍵，在於未來要做什麼產品、採用什麼技術與鎖定何種應用，目前這些定位尚未完全確定，因此仍不宜過早給出具體數字。
方略強調，一旦二期的技術與產品方向確定，公司就能進一步說明投資金額、產能與時程；現階段最重要的仍是持續聽取客戶需求，確保新的12吋投資能建立在清楚且可長期發展的市場定位之上。
paras_en: World Advanced (5347‑TW) and VSMC Chairman Fang Lue said today (the 28th) that VSMC’s progress is ahead of schedule and that a risky pilot run could begin in Q4 this year, keeping the plan for mass production in Q1 next year. Power‑management chips and silicon interposer products will start shipping, and break‑even, profitability and full‑load milestones could all be moved forward. The company has already received numerous customer requests and is evaluating the conditions, noting that Phase‑2 planning is being accelerated and that moving to a 22/28‑nm process is not ruled out.

Phase‑1 uses 130‑nm to 40‑nm processes to produce mixed‑signal, power‑management, analog and silicon‑interposer products. Full capacity is expected by 2029, with a monthly output of 44,000 12‑inch wafers, which could create about 1,600 jobs.

Fang noted that Phase‑1 capacity is already fully booked, and any additional demand will have to wait for Phase‑2. The company has begun gathering financial, customer‑demand and technology‑positioning data, hinting that it will assess the Phase‑2 start‑up timing in the "near future." Regarding speculation that Phase‑2 could be finalized by year‑end and break ground next year, he said the company is not in a hurry, will plan carefully before acting, but will move quickly once a decision is made.

VSMC has started to collect the various conditions needed to evaluate Phase‑2, including financial status, customer demand, technology positioning and application direction. Fang stressed that a 12‑inch fab requires massive investment, and a wrong positioning could create structural problems, so all financial, demand and technical aspects must be clarified before formally launching Phase‑2.

Fang believes that, compared with Phase‑1, the overall difficulty of a formally launched Phase‑2 will be lower. With the first 12‑inch fab crossing construction and mass‑production thresholds, World Advanced’s revenue will grow sharply, reducing financial pressure for a second fab. Moreover, after building Phase‑1, the team’s construction experience and execution capability have improved markedly, and some facilities and building foundations are already in place, so theoretically Phase‑2 should be easier to start than Phase‑1.

Regarding whether a third partner might join Phase‑2, Fang stated clearly that there is no such plan; Phase‑2 will continue to be a joint effort with NXP (NXPI‑US) and no additional partner will be sought.

On mass‑production timing, Fang said there is an opportunity for limited risky pilot runs in Q4 this year, but the official schedule still targets mass production in Q1 next year. The outlook for a Q1 start is strong, and the product lineup will include power‑management chips and silicon interposers among others.
As for the original plan to reach full capacity by 2029, Fang said that at the current pace "there is no problem achieving that goal" and it may even be reached earlier.

Fang remains cautious about the investment amount and technical scope of Phase‑2. He noted that the key to determining the scale of investment lies in the future product mix, the technologies to be used and the target applications, which have not yet been fully defined, so it is premature to give concrete figures.

He emphasized that once the technology and product direction for Phase‑2 are settled, the company can specify the investment amount, capacity and schedule. For now, the priority is to keep listening to customer needs and ensure that the new 12‑inch investment is built on a clear, long‑term market positioning.

items.title: 〈VSMC開幕〉方略：產能已經「徹底爆掉」 成熟製程缺貨恐延續多年
items.title_en: <VSMC Opening> Fang Lue: Capacity Has Been "Completely Exhausted"; Mature Process Shortages May Persist for Years
paras: 世界先進(5347-TW)暨VSMC董事長方略今(28)日表示，AI浪潮對全球半導體產生明顯的產能排擠效應，不只AI相關需求強勁，許多非AI應用的成熟製程產能也同步受到擠壓，世界先進目前8吋產能利用率已經「徹底爆掉」，大家都嫌不夠，預期此次AI浪潮帶來的缺貨效應將持續相當長的一段時間。
方略指出，目前全球半導體產業面臨的最大趨勢，就是AI帶動的大規模投資，使得相關資金、電力、水力、人才與產能持續向AI領域集中，也進一步排擠其他應用所需產能。世界先進本身同樣受惠AI趨勢，但另一方面，非AI相關應用也因產能被排擠，讓整體供應更加吃緊。
他認為，從目前狀況來看，全球半導體供不應求並非短期現象，而可能維持相當長一段時間。尤其這一波需求與過去成熟製程常見的季節性景氣循環不同，不像過去短期上上下下後很快恢復平衡，而是可能延續更久。
方略直言，目前全球幾乎沒有一家半導體業者能說自己有足夠產能完全滿足需求，不論亞洲、美洲或歐洲，產能都相當吃緊。
談到世界先進既有8吋產能，方略更以「徹底爆掉」形容目前利用率狀況，坦言市場需求強到大家都嫌產能不夠，AI帶來的排擠效應，也讓原本成熟製程的供需結構出現明顯變化。
除了傳統成熟製程需求外，新的AI相關應用也進一步擴大成熟製程需求，世界先進在AI Edge、Smart Power System等領域已具備不錯的位置，未來隨VSMC加入，公司在AI相關市場的布局可望進一步加深。
另外，台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)也將矽中介層(Silicon Interposer)外包給與世界先進，成為VSMC成熟製程的新需求來源。方略指出，矽中介層是先進封裝中的核心元件之一，目前在VSMC規劃中的占比已相當顯著，但由於相關製程步驟較多、需要更多設備，也因此壓縮無塵室空間，進一步限制整體晶圓產出。
至於這波供不應求何時才會出現明顯緩解，方略表示，目前市場看法分歧，有人認為要到2027年底，也有人認為會延續至2028年，甚至有人判斷到2030年都還無法完全滿足需求，現階段仍難以準確預測。
他也強調，即便外界開始出現AI投資可能放緩的討論，也不代表半導體產能會因此突然空出來。從目前趨勢來看，AI需求已具備相當強的延續性，短期內並沒有看到供需反轉的跡象。
paras_en: World Advanced (5347-TW) and VSMC Chairman Fang Lue said today (the 28th) that the AI wave is creating a clear capacity‑crowding effect in the global semiconductor industry. Not only is AI‑related demand strong, but many non‑AI mature‑process capacities are also being squeezed. World Advanced’s 8‑inch capacity utilization is already "completely exhausted"—everyone complains it’s not enough. The shortage effect driven by this AI wave is expected to last for a considerable period of time.

Fang pointed out that the biggest trend facing the global semiconductor industry today is the massive AI‑driven investment, which concentrates capital, electricity, water, talent and capacity in the AI sector and further crowds out capacity needed for other applications. World Advanced also benefits from the AI trend, but on the other hand, non‑AI applications are suffering from the capacity squeeze, tightening overall supply.

He believes that, based on the current situation, the global semiconductor supply shortage is not a short‑term phenomenon and may persist for a fairly long time. This wave of demand differs from the usual seasonal cycles of mature processes; unlike past short‑term fluctuations that quickly rebalance, this shortage could last much longer.

Fang bluntly stated that almost no semiconductor company worldwide can claim to have enough capacity to fully meet demand. Whether in Asia, the Americas or Europe, capacity is extremely tight everywhere.

Discussing World Advanced’s existing 8‑inch capacity, Fang described the utilization as "completely exhausted," admitting that market demand is so strong that everyone feels capacity is insufficient. The AI‑induced crowding effect has also caused a noticeable shift in the supply‑demand structure of mature processes.

In addition to traditional mature‑process demand, new AI‑related applications are further expanding the need for mature processes. World Advanced already holds a solid position in AI Edge and Smart Power System fields, and with VSMC’s addition, the company’s AI market footprint is expected to deepen further.

Moreover, TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) will outsource silicon interposer production to World Advanced, creating a new source of demand for VSMC’s mature processes. Fang noted that silicon interposers are a core component of advanced packaging; they now represent a significant share of VSMC’s roadmap, but the many process steps and equipment requirements compress clean‑room space, further limiting overall wafer output.

Regarding when this supply‑demand imbalance might ease, Fang said market opinions diverge: some see relief only by the end of 2027, others think it could extend into 2028, and some even predict that demand won’t be fully met until 2030. At present, accurate forecasting remains difficult.

He also emphasized that even if discussions arise about a possible slowdown in AI investment, it does not mean semiconductor capacity will suddenly become available. Current trends show AI demand has strong continuity, and there are no signs of a supply‑demand reversal in the short term.

items.title: 無懼單月調節！外資上櫃持股市值比攀24.61%新高 護國群山撐起5兆市值
items.title_en: Undaunted by Monthly Adjustments! Foreign Ownership in the OTC Market Hits a Record 24.61% as the National Champions Support a NT$5 Trillion Valuation
paras: 受惠於台股多頭氣勢強勁，櫃買市場呈現價量齊揚盛況！根據櫃買中心最新公布截至今年（115年）9月22日統計數據，櫃買指數今年以來暴漲50.29%，表現優於大盤。更吸睛的是，外資持股市值比重強勢衝上24.61%，刷新歷史紀錄，加上截至8月底，上櫃及興櫃半導體族群總市值已突破5兆元，凸顯國際資金對中小型台股與半導體供應鏈的高度的青睞。
今年台股在科技產業與AI熱潮帶動下展現驚人韌性。櫃買市場交投極度活絡，截至9月22日止，上櫃股票日均成交值達2,248.41億元，興櫃股票日均值亦達102.13億元。
在指數表現方面，代表櫃買市場的大盤指數今年以來大漲50.29%；聚焦高市值與獲利佳企業的「富櫃50指數」更一馬當先，強勢上漲81.57%；涵蓋中小型優質股的「富櫃200指數」亦大幅加溫，上漲66.19%，展現中小型股凌厲的作多氣勢。
【表一】115年櫃買市場主要指數與成交量表現
資料來源：櫃買中心

外資持股比例突破24.6% 創歷史新高

雖然外資在9月份累計賣超上櫃股票1,085.12億元（截至9月22日），且外資買賣占比略降至30.10%，但在上櫃公司股價大幅飆升帶動下，外資持股市值占全市場比重一路衝高，從113年底的16.94%、114年底的19.71%，一口氣攀升至今年9月22日的 24.61%，創下歷史新高紀錄！
回顧歷史數據，外資持股比例自111年低點（17.20%）以來呈逐年翻揚態勢，顯示即便短期調節獲利入袋，國際外資對臺灣上櫃市場的基本面及中長期成長前景仍具備極高信心。
【表二】近六年外資持股比例與買賣超變動比較
資料來源：櫃買中心

半導體集群發威 基本面支撐高估值

法人分析，今年櫃買指數能有驚人表現，主要歸功於半導體聚落及高股息殖利率基本面的強烈支撐。截至8月底，上櫃及興櫃半導體族群總市值已突破5兆元，加上800多家上櫃公司今年前8月累計營收達2.55兆元（年增30%），提供了穩固的成長基石。
外資持股市值比例攻克24%大關，反映國際資金對臺灣中小型隱形冠軍的戰略性配置需求增加。儘管籌碼面短期呈現賣超調節，但在富櫃50龍頭股帶領下，櫃買市場的多頭架構與資金充沛度依然十分穩健。
paras_en: Benefiting from the strong bullish momentum in Taiwan's stock market, the over‑the‑counter (OTC) market has seen both price and volume surge. According to the latest data released by the OTC Center covering up to September 22, 2026 (Year 115 of the ROC calendar), the OTC index has jumped 50.29% year‑to‑date, outperforming the main market. Even more striking, foreign investors' share of market value surged to 24.61%, a historic high, and by the end of August the combined market capitalization of listed and emerging‑board semiconductor groups had broken the NT$5 trillion mark, underscoring international capital’s strong appetite for Taiwan’s mid‑ and small‑cap stocks and its semiconductor supply chain.

This year Taiwan’s equities have shown remarkable resilience, driven by the technology sector and the AI boom. Trading activity in the OTC market is extremely vigorous; as of September 22, the average daily turnover for listed OTC stocks reached NT$224.841 billion, while emerging‑board stocks posted an average daily value of NT$10.213 billion.

In terms of index performance, the broad OTC market index has surged 50.29% year‑to‑date. The "Fugu 50 Index," which tracks high‑market‑cap, high‑profit companies, leads the pack with an 81.57% rise, while the "Fugu 200 Index," covering quality mid‑ and small‑cap stocks, has climbed 66.19%, highlighting the aggressive buying pressure on smaller stocks.
Table 1: Performance of Major OTC Market Indices and Trading Volumes for Year 115
Source: OTC Center

Foreign Ownership Breaks 24.6%, Setting a New Record
Although foreign investors sold a cumulative NT$108.512 billion of listed OTC shares in September (as of September 22) and their trading share slipped slightly to 30.10%, the sharp rise in listed OTC stock prices lifted the proportion of market value held by foreigners to new heights. Their share rose from 16.94% at the end of 2023, to 19.71% at the end of 2024, and jumped to 24.61% by September 22, 2026, establishing a historic peak.

Looking back at historical data, foreign ownership has been climbing year after year since its low of 17.20% in 2022, indicating that even if short‑term profit‑taking occurs, international investors remain highly confident in the fundamentals and medium‑ to long‑term growth prospects of Taiwan’s OTC market.
Table 2: Comparison of Foreign Ownership Ratios and Net Buying/Selling Over the Past Six Years
Source: OTC Center

Semiconductor Cluster Drives Performance; Fundamentals Support High Valuations
Analysts attribute this year’s impressive OTC index performance primarily to the strong backing from the semiconductor cluster and high dividend yields. By the end of August, the total market cap of listed and emerging‑board semiconductor companies had surpassed NT$5 trillion. Moreover, more than 800 listed OTC companies generated NT$2.55 trillion in revenue in the first eight months of the year—a 30% year‑over‑year increase—providing a solid growth foundation.

Foreign ownership crossing the 24% threshold reflects growing strategic allocation by international capital to Taiwan’s hidden champions among mid‑ and small‑cap firms. Although short‑term net selling has occurred, the bullish structure of the market, led by the leading stocks in the Fugu 50, remains robust and well‑funded.

items.title: 〈VSMC開幕〉VSMC建廠僅花20.5個月創新紀錄 第二期挑戰18個月
items.title_en: <VSMC Opening> VSMC Built Its Plant in Just 20.5 Months, Setting a New Record; Phase‑2 Targeted at 18 Months
paras: 世界先進(5347-TW)與恩智浦(NXP)合資成立的VSMC新加坡12吋晶圓廠正式啟用，新加坡貿工部(MTI)能源與工業部長陳詩龍今(28)日表示，VSMC從動土、完成廠房、無塵室及設備裝機到開始生產，實際僅花約20.5個月，不僅創下新加坡晶圓廠建造紀錄，以全球標準來看也屬相當快速，甚至有望成為未來新加坡吸引半導體投資的新建廠標竿。
台積電營運暨廠務副總莊子壽會後受訪時表示，VSMC從動土到廠房落成約22個月，建廠速度已相當快，其中一項關鍵在於廠房沒有地下室，相較需要開挖地下室的晶圓廠，可省下數個月施工時間；若未來啟動二期廠，因基礎條件已逐步到位，建設時間還有機會進一步縮短至18個月，可減少4個月。
VSMC本次廠務工程由多家台廠夥伴協力完成，包括亞翔(6139-TW)董事姚智薰、帆宣(6196-TW)董事長高新明、漢唐(2404-TW)董事長李惠文、漢科(3402-TW)董事長溫永宏與總經理謝清泉都親臨現場祝賀。
陳詩龍表示，不到兩年前才來到同一地點參加VSMC動土典禮，如今再度回到現場，新廠已完成廠房主體、無塵室建置、先進設備安裝並開始生產，整體計畫從動土到此次正式開幕約22個月，但實際廠房完工時間更短，約僅20.5個月，且今年5、6月左右就已有首批晶片產出。
陳詩龍指出，VSMC此次執行效率相當亮眼，「這是新加坡晶圓廠建造的新紀錄」，即便放到全球比較，速度也相當快，目前正與新加坡經濟發展局(EDB)同仁討論，VSMC此次建廠經驗是否能成為未來新加坡晶圓廠建設的新標準，在持續吸引國際半導體投資之際，進一步複製相關經驗。
他也特別感謝VSMC工程師、技術人員、承包商、供應商及政府機構，共同讓新廠能在短時間內完成建設並投入生產。
談到半導體產業前景，陳詩龍表示，全球半導體正進入前所未有的成長階段，市場規模預計將持續大幅擴張。儘管目前市場目光多集中在驅動人工智慧(AI)的最先進邏輯晶片，但特殊製程半導體同樣不可或缺。
他指出，與主要透過電晶體密度提升效能的先進邏輯晶片不同，特殊製程晶片是針對特定功能及應用最佳化，例如電源管理、感測，以及汽車與工業設備的控制系統等，隨著電氣化、聯網裝置及工業自動化快速發展，相關需求也持續增加。
陳詩龍表示，新加坡過去數十年已建立完整的特殊製程半導體能力，VSMC將進一步建立在既有產業基礎上。根據規劃，VSMC將聚焦40至130奈米特殊製程，規劃產能達每月4.4萬片12吋晶圓，產品應用涵蓋嵌入式快閃記憶體(eFlash)、電源管理以及車用系統等。
陳詩龍表示，待VSMC產能全面開出後，將大幅提升新加坡半導體製造實力，也將進一步鞏固新加坡作為全球半導體供應鏈可信賴節點的地位。
同時，VSMC帶來的效益不只侷限於晶圓製造本身，還將向外擴散至整體半導體生態系，包括特殊化學品與氣體、半導體設備服務、廠務以及物流等領域，為新加坡在地供應商創造更多機會。
陳詩龍強調，一項重大半導體投資的意義，不只是帶來多少資本與技術，更重要的是能建立多少產業能力，以及為當地人才創造多少發展機會。
在人力布局方面，VSMC預計將創造1,600個新工作機會，其中約75%屬於專業、管理、行政與技術人員(PMET)職務，包括工程師、化學家及資料科學家等，未來將負責操作先進製造設備、晶圓製程開發與生產，以及透過自動化持續最佳化製造流程。
陳詩龍表示，這些職位將讓新加坡人才有機會在持續成長的半導體產業中累積深度技能，並建立長期職涯。
除了直接創造職缺，VSMC也正擴大與新加坡大專院校合作。陳詩龍指出，VSMC近期與當地理工學院及大學簽署7項合作備忘錄，合作內容涵蓋實習、畢業生招聘、共同開發課程，以及應用研究與創新計畫。
相關合作也將透過導師制度及產業參訪等方式，讓學生提早接觸半導體產業，培養與先進製造直接相關的技能，並進一步了解產業中的不同職涯發展機會。
陳詩龍表示，VSMC也參與新加坡相關人才培訓及產業實習計畫，未來並規劃擴大工程職缺招募，協助應屆畢業生與中途轉職人才透過結構化培訓及在職經驗進入半導體產業，這些布局將確保新加坡半導體產業成長的同時，也能轉化成更多高品質工作及長期職涯機會，政府也期待VSMC持續與大專院校、產業協會及政府機構合作，進一步強化本地半導體人才基礎。
展望後市，陳詩龍表示，半導體產業正處於新一波「超級循環」的起點，新加坡政府將盡可能鼓勵更多相關投資進入新加坡，也會借鏡VSMC此次的最佳實務，協助未來專案以更快速度落地。
他指出，在半導體產業快速成長的環境下，建廠時間愈長，所付出的機會成本也愈高，因此政府希望透過VSMC此次經驗，讓未來投資案能「蓋得更好、也蓋得更快」。
paras_en: World Advanced (5347‑TW) and NXP (NXP) joint‑venture VSMC’s new 12‑inch wafer fab in Singapore was officially inaugurated. Singapore’s Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) Energy and Industry Minister Chen Shilong said on the 28th that VSMC took only about 20.5 months from groundbreaking, building completion, clean‑room and equipment installation to start of production – a record for Singapore wafer fabs and, by global standards, exceptionally fast, potentially becoming a benchmark for future semiconductor investments in Singapore.

TSMC Operations and Facilities Vice President Zhuang Zishou told reporters after the meeting that VSMC’s construction from groundbreaking to building completion took roughly 22 months, already a very rapid pace. A key factor was the absence of a basement, which saves several months compared with fabs that require underground excavation. If a second phase is launched, the already‑in‑place groundwork could allow the build time to be further cut to 18 months, shaving off another four months.

The VSMC plant engineering was carried out with the cooperation of several Taiwanese partners, including Yaxiang (6139‑TW) director Yao Zhixun, Fanxuan (6196‑TW) chairman Gao Xinming, Hantang (2404‑TW) chairman Li Huiwen, Hanke (3402‑TW) chairman Wen Yonghong and general manager Xie Qingquan, all of whom attended the ceremony.

Chen Shilong noted that less than two years ago he was at the groundbreaking ceremony at the same site. Now, returning to the location, the new plant has completed the main building, clean‑rooms, advanced equipment installation and has begun production. The overall schedule from groundbreaking to this official opening was about 22 months, but the actual building completion was even shorter—around 20.5 months—and the first batch of chips was already produced around May‑June this year.

Chen emphasized that VSMC’s execution efficiency was outstanding, calling it “a new record for Singapore wafer‑fab construction.” Even by global comparison the speed is impressive. He said discussions are underway with the Singapore Economic Development Board (EDB) on whether VSMC’s experience can become a new standard for future Singapore wafer‑fab projects, helping to replicate the model as Singapore continues to attract international semiconductor investment.

He also expressed special thanks to VSMC engineers, technicians, contractors, suppliers and government agencies for jointly enabling the new plant to be built and put into production in such a short time.

Speaking on the semiconductor industry outlook, Chen said the global semiconductor sector is entering an unprecedented growth phase, with market size expected to expand dramatically. Although current market attention is largely on the most advanced logic chips that drive artificial intelligence (AI), specialty‑process semiconductors are equally indispensable.

He explained that unlike advanced logic chips that gain performance mainly through higher transistor density, specialty‑process chips are optimized for specific functions and applications such as power management, sensing, and control systems for automotive and industrial equipment. As electrification, connected devices, and industrial automation accelerate, demand for these chips continues to rise.

Chen said Singapore has built a complete specialty‑process semiconductor capability over the past decades, and VSMC will build on that foundation. According to the plan, VSMC will focus on 40‑ to 130‑nm specialty processes, targeting a capacity of 44,000 twelve‑inch wafers per month. The products will serve embedded flash memory (eFlash), power‑management and automotive systems, among others.

He added that once VSMC’s capacity is fully ramped, it will significantly boost Singapore’s semiconductor manufacturing strength and further cement Singapore’s role as a trusted node in the global semiconductor supply chain.

The benefits of VSMC extend beyond wafer fabrication; they will also ripple through the broader semiconductor ecosystem, including specialty chemicals and gases, equipment services, plant operations and logistics, creating more opportunities for local suppliers.

Chen stressed that the significance of a major semiconductor investment lies not only in the capital and technology it brings, but also in the industrial capabilities it builds and the development opportunities it creates for local talent.

In terms of manpower, VSMC expects to create 1,600 new jobs, about 75 % of which will be professional, managerial, administrative and technical (PMET) positions such as engineers, chemists and data scientists. These staff will operate advanced manufacturing equipment, develop wafer processes and production, and continuously optimise the manufacturing flow through automation.
Chen said these roles will give Singaporean talent the chance to acquire deep skills in a growing semiconductor industry and build long‑term careers.

Beyond direct job creation, VSMC is expanding collaborations with Singapore’s polytechnics and universities. Chen noted that VSMC recently signed seven memoranda of understanding with local institutes covering internships, graduate recruitment, joint curriculum development, and applied research and innovation projects.

The collaborations will also involve mentorship programmes and industry visits, allowing students early exposure to the semiconductor sector, cultivating skills directly relevant to advanced manufacturing and helping them understand the various career paths within the industry.

Chen added that VSMC participates in Singapore’s talent‑training and industry‑internship programmes and plans to broaden engineering recruitment, helping fresh graduates and mid‑career switchers enter the semiconductor field through structured training and on‑the‑job experience. These initiatives will ensure that as Singapore’s semiconductor industry grows, it translates into high‑quality jobs and long‑term career opportunities, and the government looks forward to VSMC’s continued cooperation with colleges, industry associations and agencies to further strengthen the local talent base.

Looking ahead, Chen said the semiconductor industry is at the start of a new “super‑cycle.” The Singapore government will encourage more related investment to flow into the country and will draw on VSMC’s best practices to help future projects be delivered more quickly.

He noted that in a rapidly expanding semiconductor sector, longer construction times increase opportunity costs, so the government hopes to use VSMC’s experience to enable future investments to “build better and build faster.”

items.title: 〈VSMC開幕〉NXP：VSMC鎖定40至130奈米 將成Physical AI製造基地
items.title_en: NXP Announces VSMC Opening: 40‑130nm Focus to Become Physical AI Manufacturing Hub
paras: NXP總裁暨執行長Rafael Sotomayor今(28)日出席VSMC開幕典禮表示，VSMC新加坡12吋晶圓廠正式啟用，不僅是VSMC的重要里程碑，也是新加坡半導體產業與全球供應鏈的重要一步。新廠將聚焦40至130奈米製程，生產混合訊號、電源管理及類比等產品，除滿足NXP市場對成熟製程的長期需求，也將成為未來Physical AI (實體AI) 發展的重要製造基礎，此次也是NXP自2015年收購Freescale Semiconductor以來最大規模的一筆投資。
Sotomayor表示，VSMC是NXP與世界先進共同合作的重要成果，也反映雙方、新加坡政府及半導體生態系夥伴共同目標與長期投入的力量。他並特別感謝世界先進董事長方略及團隊，強調世界先進在晶圓廠營運方面具備深厚經驗，是VSMC一路發展的重要合作夥伴。
他指出，世界先進對如何成功營運世界級12吋晶圓廠有深入理解，未來雙方將共同確保VSMC具備長期競爭力，不僅滿足客戶對創新半導體解決方案的需求，也維持NXP不可或缺的成熟製程供應。
在製程布局方面，Sotomayor表示，VSMC將聚焦130奈米至40奈米技術，生產混合訊號、電源管理及類比相關產品。相關製程與產品組合是經過策略性選擇，可支援多元應用及產業，確保未來多年能持續滿足全球客戶需求。
不過，Sotomayor強調，VSMC的意義不只是增加一座新的半導體工廠，更代表NXP長期強化全球半導體生態系、提升供應鏈韌性，以及建立未來科技所需產能的承諾，其中也包括快速發展的AI與機器人應用。
Sotomayor指出，AI正從雲端與資料中心進一步走入實體世界，讓汽車、機器人、工廠與基礎設施具備即時感知、決策及行動能力，將智慧運算帶到最需要的地方，目前也被稱為「Physical AI (實體AI)」。
他進一步表示，NXP認為未來不只會由Physical AI定義，更重要的是「Trusted Physical AI（可信任實體AI）」。原因在於，只有將信任、安全與資安能力真正設計進智慧邊緣裝置，Physical AI才有機會大規模進入真實世界。
要實現這項願景，需要能夠安全連接、運算、感測及即時回應的可信任技術，同時滿足實體世界對即時效能、功能安全與資訊安全的要求，而半導體正處於這場轉型的核心，VSMC也將成為支撐Physical AI發展的重要基礎設施。
Sotomayor指出，透過擴大晶圓製造產能並提升供應鏈韌性，VSMC將協助確保驅動下一代智慧邊緣系統的半導體能穩定供應全球客戶，同時進一步強化NXP滿足市場需求的能力，協助客戶設計、部署並擴大Trusted Physical AI解決方案。
除了製造能力，VSMC也將成為半導體人才培育的重要基地。Sotomayor表示，新廠不只會是推動創新的催化劑，也將協助培養下一代工程人才、創造技能發展機會，並進一步壯大新加坡半導體生態系。
談及新加坡布局，Sotomayor指出，新加坡憑藉政府長期政策支持、世界級基礎建設以及高素質人才，已建立成熟且具競爭力的半導體產業生態系，NXP很自豪能成為其中的一員。
Sotomayor更透露，NXP此次投資VSMC，是公司在新加坡長期發展歷程中的重要里程碑，同時也是NXP自2015年收購Freescale Semiconductor以來最大規模的一筆投資，凸顯公司對VSMC及新加坡半導體產業的長期承諾。
他回顧，NXP與世界先進2024年宣布成立VSMC合資公司，同年即啟動建廠，經過約兩年工程建設，如今正式迎來新廠啟用，期間仰賴VSMC團隊、承包商、供應商及營建團隊共同投入，也獲得新加坡政府、經濟發展局(EDB)及相關政府機構大力支持。
展望後續，Sotomayor表示，VSMC未來將生產實現Trusted Physical AI所需要的半導體解決方案，同時進一步提升全球半導體供應鏈韌性，並強調「雙方共同打造的不只是一座新的晶圓廠」，更是為未來成長、科技以及雙方進一步合作奠定基礎。
paras_en: NXP President and CEO Rafael Sotomayor attended the VSMC opening ceremony today (28th), stating that the new 12‑inch wafer fab in Singapore is not only a major milestone for VSMC but also an important step for Singapore’s semiconductor industry and the global supply chain. The plant will focus on 40‑130nm processes, producing mixed‑signal, power‑management and analog products, meeting NXP’s long‑term demand for mature nodes and serving as a key manufacturing foundation for future Physical AI development. This is NXP’s largest investment since acquiring Freescale Semiconductor in 2015.

Sotomayor said VSMC is a significant result of the partnership between NXP and GlobalFoundries, reflecting the combined effort of both companies, the Singapore government and semiconductor ecosystem partners. He thanked GlobalFoundries chairman and team, emphasizing that GlobalFoundries’ deep wafer‑fab operating experience has been a crucial partner in VSMC’s development.

He noted that GlobalFoundries has a deep understanding of how to successfully run a world‑class 12‑inch fab, and that the two companies will work together to ensure VSMC remains competitive over the long term, satisfying customers’ need for innovative semiconductor solutions while maintaining NXP’s essential mature‑process supply.

Regarding process focus, Sotomayor said VSMC will concentrate on 130nm to 40nm technologies, producing mixed‑signal, power‑management and analog‑related products. This strategic mix of processes and product families supports diverse applications and industries, ensuring the fab can meet global customer demand for many years to come.

However, Sotomayor stressed that VSMC’s significance goes beyond adding another semiconductor plant; it represents NXP’s long‑term commitment to strengthening the global semiconductor ecosystem, enhancing supply‑chain resilience, and building capacity needed for future technologies, including the fast‑growing AI and robotics markets.

Sotomayor pointed out that AI is moving from cloud and data‑center environments into the physical world, giving cars, robots, factories and infrastructure real‑time perception, decision‑making and actuation capabilities—what is now called “Physical AI.”

He added that NXP believes the future will be defined not only by Physical AI but by “Trusted Physical AI.” Trust, safety and cybersecurity must be built into intelligent edge devices for Physical AI to scale widely in the real world.

Achieving this vision requires trusted technologies that can securely connect, compute, sense and respond in real time, while meeting the physical world’s demands for performance, functional safety and information security. Semiconductors are at the core of this transformation, and VSMC will become a key infrastructure supporting Physical AI development.

Sotomayor said that by expanding wafer‑manufacturing capacity and improving supply‑chain resilience, VSMC will help ensure a stable supply of semiconductors that power next‑generation intelligent edge systems for customers worldwide, further strengthening NXP’s ability to meet market demand and assist customers in designing, deploying and scaling Trusted Physical AI solutions.

Beyond manufacturing, VSMC will also serve as an important hub for semiconductor talent development. Sotomayor said the new plant will act as a catalyst for innovation and help train the next generation of engineers, create skill‑development opportunities, and further grow Singapore’s semiconductor ecosystem.

Discussing Singapore’s landscape, Sotomayor highlighted that Singapore’s long‑term government policy support, world‑class infrastructure and high‑quality talent have created a mature and competitive semiconductor ecosystem, and NXP is proud to be part of it.

Sotomayor disclosed that NXP’s investment in VSMC marks a major milestone in the company’s long‑term development in Singapore and is the largest investment since the 2015 acquisition of Freescale Semiconductor, underscoring NXP’s long‑term commitment to VSMC and Singapore’s semiconductor industry.

He recalled that NXP and GlobalFoundries announced the VSMC joint venture in 2024, broke ground the same year, and after roughly two years of construction, the fab is now officially operational. The effort relied on the VSMC team, contractors, suppliers and construction crews, as well as strong support from the Singapore government, the Economic Development Board and related agencies.

Looking ahead, Sotomayor said VSMC will produce the semiconductor solutions needed for Trusted Physical AI and further enhance global semiconductor supply‑chain resilience, emphasizing that “what the two sides are building together is not just a new fab,” but a foundation for future growth, technology and deeper collaboration.

items.title: 〈VSMC開幕〉12吋廠正式啟用 方略感謝NXP、台積電 莊子壽現身典禮
items.title_en: VSMC Opening: 12-Inch Fab Officially Launched, Fang Luei Thanks NXP and TSMC, Zhuang Zishou Attends Ceremony
paras: 世界先進(5347-TW)與恩智浦(MXP)合資成立的VSMC今(28)日於新加坡淡濱尼舉辦新廠開幕典禮，董事長方略表示，歷經約兩年建設，VSMC已從當初的一片空地，正式成為具備量產能力的12吋晶圓廠，不僅代表產能擴充，也將進一步強化全球半導體供應鏈韌性，同時也感謝合資夥伴恩智浦與台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)的協助。台積電營運暨廠務副總莊子壽也親自到場見證新廠啟用。
VSMC於2024年正式成立，並於同年12月舉辦12吋晶圓廠動土儀式，歷時22個月完成建廠，並已順利試產首批晶圓，良率超過99%，預計將於2027年第一季量產。該晶圓廠將採用130奈米至40奈米製程技術，生產混合訊號、電源管理、類比產品及矽中介層等產品，以支援高速運算、行動裝置、車用、工業及消費性電子等終端市場需求。
VSMC一期預計於2029年達滿載，月產能達44,000片12吋晶圓，可望創造約1,600個工作機會，並進一步帶動新加坡半導體產業生態系發展，為區域高科技產業創造更多合作機會與長期經濟效益。
方略表示，大約兩年前，團隊就在同一地點舉行動土典禮，當時眼前仍只是一片空曠綠地，如今，當初的願景已經化為一座12吋晶圓廠，新廠展現VSMC對卓越製造、創新及長期合作夥伴關係的承諾，未來將服務全球客戶，並支援半導體產業持續成長。
方略指出，VSMC已經不再只是一項計畫，而是成為現實，這項成果也再次證明，重大成就從來無法單靠一家公司完成，而是建立在合作、信任以及共同追求成功的決心之上。
他更進一步表示，半導體產業正處於全球科技轉型核心，隨著市場需求持續成長，可靠的製造能力以及具韌性的供應鏈，比以往任何時候都更加重要，VSMC成立的目的，正是為了支援產業成長，同時強化全球供應鏈韌性。
方略強調，VSMC所代表的不只是新增產能，也將帶來更多創新、合作及永續成長機會，未來衡量VSMC成功與否的標準，不會只著眼於建立多少產能，更重要的是能為客戶、員工及社會創造多少價值。
在合作夥伴方面，方略首先感謝合資夥伴NXP。他指出，VSMC的發展始於雙方2024年簽署合資協議，自此NXP一路與世界先進共享相同願景與承諾，今日新廠正式啟用，也反映雙方合作關係的成果。
方略也感謝台積電，表示台積電在VSMC籌建過程中提供極其重要的支持，從晶圓廠建設、技術移轉到員工培訓，均扮演關鍵角色，協助VSMC建立穩固的營運基礎，相當感謝台積電所提供的專業能力以及持續支持，並強調台積電對VSMC而言，不只是重要合作夥伴，同時也是關鍵客戶。
此次VSMC新廠啟用，台積電代表莊子壽也親自到場，與世界先進、NXP及新加坡政府等各方代表共同見證VSMC正式邁入營運新階段。
除產業夥伴外，方略也感謝新加坡政府及相關機構一路支持。他表示，新加坡是全球科技與先進製造的重要樞紐，具備完整人才、基礎建設及創新能力，對VSMC而言，新加坡不只是一個設廠地點，更是公司未來發展的重要策略夥伴；VSMC很自豪能成為新加坡半導體生態系的一員，此次投資也反映公司對新加坡在全球半導體產業中長期角色的信心。
方略也向營建夥伴、供應商、承包商以及專案團隊致謝，指出建造半導體晶圓廠是全球最複雜的工程之一，正是仰賴各方專業、投入及團隊合作，才能將原本的願景轉化為今日正式啟用的晶圓廠。
paras_en: World Advanced (5347-TW) and NXP (MXP) joint venture VSMC held its new‑plant opening ceremony today (28th) in Tampines, Singapore. Chairman Fang Luei said that after about two years of construction, VSMC has turned a former vacant lot into a mass‑production‑capable 12‑inch wafer fab, representing capacity expansion and further strengthening the resilience of the global semiconductor supply chain. He also thanked joint‑venture partner NXP and TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) for their assistance. TSMC’s Vice President of Operations and Facilities, Zhuang Zishou, was present to witness the launch.

VSMC was formally established in 2024 and held a groundbreaking ceremony for the 12‑inch fab in December of the same year. The plant was built in 22 months, has already completed trial production of its first wafers with yields exceeding 99%, and is slated to begin volume production in Q1 2027. The fab will use 130‑nm to 40‑nm process technologies to produce mixed‑signal, power‑management, analog and silicon‑intermediate‑layer products, supporting high‑speed computing, mobile devices, automotive, industrial and consumer electronics markets.

Phase 1 of VSMC is expected to reach full capacity by 2029, with a monthly output of 44,000 12‑inch wafers, creating roughly 1,600 jobs and further stimulating Singapore’s semiconductor ecosystem, generating more regional high‑tech collaboration opportunities and long‑term economic benefits.

Fang said that about two years ago the team held the groundbreaking ceremony on the same site, which at the time was just an empty green field. Today that vision has become a 12‑inch wafer fab. The new plant demonstrates VSMC’s commitment to excellent manufacturing, innovation and long‑term partnership, and will serve global customers while supporting continued growth of the semiconductor industry.

Fang noted that VSMC is no longer merely a plan but a reality, and this achievement again proves that major accomplishments cannot be achieved by a single company alone but are built on cooperation, trust and a shared determination to succeed.

He added that the semiconductor industry sits at the core of the global technology transformation. As market demand keeps growing, reliable manufacturing capacity and a resilient supply chain are more important than ever. VSMC was created to support industry growth and to strengthen global supply‑chain resilience.

Fang emphasized that VSMC represents more than added capacity; it will bring additional innovation, collaboration and sustainable growth opportunities. Future measures of VSMC’s success will not focus solely on how much capacity is built, but on the value created for customers, employees and society.

Regarding partners, Fang first thanked joint‑venture partner NXP. He pointed out that VSMC’s development began with the signing of the joint‑venture agreement in 2024, and since then NXP has shared the same vision and commitment with World Advanced. The official opening of the new plant reflects the results of their cooperation.

Fang also thanked TSMC, saying that TSMC provided extremely important support throughout VSMC’s construction, from fab building and technology transfer to staff training, playing a key role in establishing a solid operational foundation. He expressed deep gratitude for TSMC’s expertise and ongoing support, stressing that TSMC is not only an important partner but also a critical customer for VSMC.

At the opening of the new VSMC fab, TSMC’s representative Zhuang Zishou attended in person, joining representatives from World Advanced, NXP, the Singapore government and others to witness VSMC’s entry into a new operational phase.

In addition to industry partners, Fang thanked the Singapore government and related agencies for their continuous support. He said Singapore is a global hub for technology and advanced manufacturing, with a complete talent pool, infrastructure and innovation capability. For VSMC, Singapore is not just a plant location but a strategic partner for future development; VSMC is proud to be part of Singapore’s semiconductor ecosystem, and the investment reflects confidence in Singapore’s long‑term role in the global semiconductor industry.

Fang also expressed gratitude to construction partners, suppliers, contractors and the project team, noting that building a semiconductor fab is one of the world’s most complex engineering projects and that only through the professionalism, dedication and teamwork of all parties could the original vision be turned into today’s operational wafer fab.

items.title_en: High‑Yield Taiwan ETFs Rank Among Top Five Performers This Year, 00929 Leads the Pack Ahead of 00878 and 00939
paras: 台股今年上演狂飆的「瘋狗浪」行情，站上 4 萬 8 大關，在全球 AI 算力需求爆發與半導體供應鏈升級潮帶動下，不只大盤屢創新高，就連高股息 ETF 也繳出亮眼績效。統計至 2026 年 9 月 25 日，今年以來高股息 ETF 績效前五強全數衝破 66%，其中復華台灣科技優息(00929-TW)更以 74.16% 的今年以來績效勇奪冠軍寶座，國泰永續高股息(00878-TW)後來居上登第二名，統一台灣高息動能(00939-TW)為第三，今年來績效雙雙超越 7 成。

根據 CMoney 統計至 2026/9/25，今年以來高股息 ETF 績效前五強依序為：復華台灣科技優息(00929-TW)以 74.16% 居冠，收盤價 29.18 元；國泰永續高股息(00878-TW)以 72.67% 緊追在後，收盤價 34.88 元；統一台灣高息動能(00939-TW)績效 71.51%，收盤價 24.13 元；大華優利高填息30(00918-TW)績效 68.66%，收盤價 33.98 元；群益科技高息成長(00946-TW)則以 66.44% 績效位居第五，收盤價 15.3 元。
00929 能在強敵環伺下穩居第一，核心在於其 100% 科技純度與精準卡位黑馬飆股。00929 在關鍵時間點升級指數規則，將成分股重倉於半導體通路雙雄(如文曄、大聯大)與中小型 AI 零組件供應鏈。
由於今年台股主軸完全由科技龍頭與 AI 供應鏈帶領，00929 在完全沒有傳統產業與低成長板塊拖累的情況下，發揮極強的進攻彈性。此外，其月配息金額隨淨值大幅成長而階梯式調升，加上強勁的填息效率，形成「淨值拉升→資本利得配息增加→吸引資金回流」的正向循環。
針對後市展望，統一台灣高息動能ETF經理人林良一 表示，台股短線上資金轉向成長類股，雖然高檔追價意願趨於保守，加上美債殖利率走高與連假消息面變數，可能加大短線震盪，但考量 AI 需求與外銷訂單持續成長，對台股中長期走勢仍維持偏多看法。林良一指出，00939 目前維持 100% 填息紀錄，兼具股息收益與平穩淨值表現，建議投資人可以定期定額方式參與市場漲跌。

大華優利高填息30 ETF經理人郭修誠則分析，AI 資本支出已從單一晶片需求進入「AI 產業鏈精準配置」階段，伺服器升級帶動半導體與 PCB/CCL 高速傳輸主題成為吸金主軸。00918 深度布局華碩、廣達、緯穎等 AI 伺服器龍頭，同時重倉中信金、兆豐金、玉山金等優質金控，展現「以金融做下檔防禦、以 AI 搶上檔爆發」的攻守兼備配置。隨著 Q4 剛性需求延伸，投資人可採用「定期定額＋股息再投資(DRIP)」策略，鎖定高股利與高填息雙因子紅利。

paras_en: Taiwan's stock market has surged this year in a "mad dog wave" rally, breaking the 48,000‑point mark. Driven by a global explosion in AI computing demand and an upgrade wave in the semiconductor supply chain, not only has the main index repeatedly hit new highs, but high‑dividend ETFs have also delivered impressive returns. As of September 25, 2026, all five top‑performing high‑dividend ETFs this year have exceeded 66% year‑to‑date gains, with Fuhua Taiwan Technology Premium Yield (00929‑TW) leading at 74.16%, followed by Cathay Sustainable High Dividend (00878‑TW) and Uni-President Taiwan High‑Yield Momentum (00939‑TW) both surpassing the 70% threshold.

According to CMoney data as of 2026/09/25, the top five high‑dividend ETFs year‑to‑date are: Fuhua Taiwan Technology Premium Yield (00929‑TW) at 74.16% with a closing price of NT$29.18; Cathay Sustainable High Dividend (00878‑TW) at 72.67% closing at NT$34.88; Uni‑President Taiwan High‑Yield Momentum (00939‑TW) at 71.51% closing at NT$24.13; Dahua Premium Yield 30 (00918‑TW) at 68.66% closing at NT$33.98; and Quanyi Technology High‑Yield Growth (00946‑TW) at 66.44% closing at NT$15.30.

00929 maintains its top spot despite strong competition thanks to its 100% technology focus and precise positioning in fast‑growing stocks. The fund upgraded its index methodology at a critical moment, concentrating holdings in the two semiconductor distribution giants (such as WPG and Da Lian Da) and in small‑ and mid‑cap AI component suppliers.

Because this year Taiwan's market is driven entirely by tech leaders and the AI supply chain, 00929 benefits from the absence of traditional, low‑growth sectors, giving it strong offensive flexibility. Its monthly dividend has risen stepwise as net asset value (NAV) grew sharply, and its efficient dividend‑catching creates a positive loop: NAV appreciation → higher capital‑gain dividends → attracting capital inflows.

Looking ahead, Uni‑President Taiwan High‑Yield Momentum ETF manager Lin Liang‑yi said short‑term capital is shifting toward growth stocks. Although buying at high levels is becoming more cautious and higher U.S. Treasury yields plus holiday‑related news could increase short‑term volatility, the continued growth in AI demand and export orders supports a bullish medium‑to‑long‑term view for Taiwan equities. Lin noted that 00939 is currently maintaining a 100% dividend‑catch record, offering both dividend yield and stable NAV performance, and recommends investors use a regular‑savings (dollar‑cost averaging) approach to participate in market moves.

Dahua Premium Yield 30 ETF manager Guo Xiucheng analyzed that AI capital spending has moved from single‑chip demand to a "precise AI industry‑chain allocation" phase, with server upgrades driving semiconductor and PCB/CCL high‑speed transmission themes as the main money magnets. 00918 is deeply invested in AI server leaders such as Asus, Quanta, and Wistron, while also holding large positions in quality financial institutions like CTBC, Mega, and E.SUN banks, showcasing a "defensive bottom line with finance and explosive top line with AI" balanced strategy. With Q4 rigid demand extending, investors can adopt a "regular‑savings plus dividend reinvestment (DRIP)" strategy to lock in both high dividend and high dividend‑catching factor returns.
